purpose: Version a minimal successor to the accepted A7 frontend so a durable SentUnconfirmed>0 action can never be mislabeled as empty/no-work or minimized by a subsequent scheduler hotkey.

historical_a7.rule: Historical D4/E1/E2 evidence remains bound to A7 at its frozen source commits; no historical authority artifact is rewritten.

behavioral_contract.true_idle: Only ReadyManualCycles=0 AND SentUnconfirmed=0 may take the existing no-work minimize path.
behavioral_contract.pending_unconfirmed: If SentUnconfirmed>0 and claim returns no new action, preserve pending state, never say Nothing needs service, never minimize, and attempt only the existing fail-closed trusted Firefox refocus.
behavioral_contract.inconsistent_ready: If ReadyManualCycles>0 but claim yields no action, do not minimize; warn and leave the worker visible.
behavioral_contract.input_boundary: Ctrl+V and Enter remain manual. No automatic typing, paste, Enter, Send, mouse input, DOM scraping, or page-content inspection is introduced.
behavioral_contract.authority_boundary: No execution authority, permission, or retry authority is created.

e3_binding_rule: A future E3 retry may use this successor only after this review head is validated and a separate fresh one-shot E3 authority explicitly binds that validated review/source. The consumed E3 authority 1f6d3639ade8469ca2a7caeab4a9fbdc1fba881d remains nonreusable.
